additional_info.subject: 0411085 - ID0411085-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S9 313882469001] SECC Syntax Error (C1) CRM:00314000171
additional_info.body:
Good morning Daniel,
I am reaching out in regards of this old ticket
ID0411085.
The ticket was opened by Johannes Dissauer for the following error on charger
zyX1So
“SyntaxError: Unexpected token”.
We already reached out to EcoG to troubleshoot the issue, and we finally got feedback from their side. According to EcoG, the error occurs when parsing the state object JSON file, and it is related to an issue on
coap
communication, hence on the EcoG FW version 1.4.5. According to EcoG, this issue should not happen on FW version v1.4.11, as the FW version uses websocket instead of coap protocol.
Nevertheless, I analyzed the logs on AWS over the past weeks on charger
zyX1So.
The SyntaxError occurs, but it is just a random and sporadic spam in the logs, hence this error does not cause an out of order state of the outlets.
As per EcoG recommendation, if you agree I would suggest to install the EcoG Hotfix v1.4.11 upon FW version v7.0.5, as it would bring not only benefits on the SyntaxError problem, but also other features that improve the overall communication and performance of the EcoG.
Once the Hotfix will be installed, I would monitor the charger to see if this error would appear again or not.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
W
ith kind regards,
Fosco Servidei

additional_info.subject: Handover from ES to NOC
additional_info.body:
Problem Description
: SECC SyntaXError is setting outlets out of order.
Suspected Root Cause
: EcoG related issue. EcoG FW has now been updated to v1.4.11. According to EcoG, this is the solution and SyntaxError should not appear anymore on v1.4.11 and set outlets out of order.
Action Performed (ES)
: Logs analysis, raised issue to EcoG and R&D, applied HF, monitored charger
Charger SW Version
: v7.0.5+HF
Reason for Handover (ES/NOC
): Issue is resolved according to EcoG. Please handle communication with region, and advise to open new ticket if it happens on v1.4.11. This ticket should be closed.
